bead.title: bench-pr-A2: bash runner skeleton — arg parsing, subcommand dispatch, matrix expansion, --plan
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The runner is a 2232-LOC Go program (cmd/bench/matrix.go). It must be replaced by a bash runner at scripts/benchmark/benchmark. This child delivers the runner's front end: argument parsing, subcommand dispatch, YAML reading, matrix expansion, and --plan dry-run. It executes NO cells (that is A3) and owns NO concurrency/signal logic (A4).

ROOT CAUSE:
- cmd/bench/matrix.go (~2232 LOC) is the monolith being retired; its host PYTHONPATH coupling (cmd/bench/matrix.go:1105) is what forces the rewrite.

PROPOSED FIX:
- scripts/benchmark/benchmark (new bash script, no extension):
  - Dispatch: ./benchmark <subcommand> with profiles | bench-sets | task-executors | harness-adapters | validate | preflight | (no subcommand = run mode).
  - Run-mode flags: --profile P[,P2] --bench-set B[,B2] [--plan] [--force-rerun] [--retry-invalid] [--reps N] [--jobs N] [--max-cost-usd X] [--out DIR]. Parse all; flags consumed by later children (A3/A4) are accepted but may be inert here.
  - Read profile / bench-set / concurrency-group YAML via `yq -o=json`.
  - Matrix expansion: profile x task x rep -> ordered cell list. Resolve `tasks_from:` references (path relative to the bench-set file) and inline `tasks:` lists. Default task_executor to harbor when framework == terminal-bench (PR C finalizes the schema).
  - preflight: rebuild fizeau-harbor-runner via build-harbor-runner.sh only when the cached image label != current content sha (uses A1).
  - --plan: print the expanded matrix and exit, creating NO files and building NO Docker images.

NON-SCOPE: per-cell execution loop / report.json composition / budget / retry (A3); concurrency + signals (A4); Go agent-leak fix, Go deactivation, parity (A5); adapters + image (A1, consumed not built here). Parent out-of-scope preserved: PR B schema; PR C bench-set schema; PR D collector; PR E importers; PR F deleting cmd/bench; PR G docs. Governing artifact plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.

DEPENDS ON: A1. BLOCKS: A3, A4, A5.

ACCEPTANCE (satisfies parent AC1):
1. ./scripts/benchmark/benchmark --plan --profile sindri-lucebox --bench-set tb-2-1-canary prints the expanded matrix, creates NO files, and builds NO Docker images. TestPlanPrintsMatrixNoSideEffects.
2. Matrix expansion resolves both `tasks_from:` (relative to the bench-set file) and inline `tasks:` and produces an ordered profile x task x rep cell list. TestMatrixExpandTasksFromAndInline.
3. Listing subcommands (profiles, bench-sets, task-executors, harness-adapters) emit their inventories and exit 0. TestListSubcommands.
4. preflight rebuilds the harbor-runner image only on label mismatch, else no-op. TestPreflightRebuildOnShaMismatch.
GATES: bats scripts/benchmark/test passes; `go test ./...` passes; `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
bead.acceptance: Parent AC1 holds; acceptance 1-4 pass; bats, go test ./..., and lefthook run pre-commit all green.
